context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 290 fully tested. Key features: (1) Booking.com Premier XML Push - GET /api/booking-com/status, POST /api/booking-com/config, POST /api/booking-com/validate-payload (rates/availability/restrictions), POST /api/booking-com/push/rates, POST /api/booking-com/push/availability, POST /api/booking-com/push/restrictions, GET /api/booking-com/push-log. endpoints: GET /api/booking-com/status - returns cert_status, endpoint_configured, credentials_configured, live_mode, hotel_count_mapped

POST /api/booking-com/config - updates endpoint_url, auth_username, cert_status, hotel_id_mapping, room_id_mapping, rate_plan_mapping. Never stores auth_password in clear (sets auth_password_set=true and hint)
POST /api/booking-com/validate-payload - validates XML structure for rates/availability/restrictions without sending
POST /api/booking-com/push/rates - pushes rates, validates daily entries have date+rate, returns attempt with status='ok' and simulated=true
POST /api/booking-com/push/availability - pushes availability, validates daily entries have date+allotment
GET /api/booking-com/push-log - returns history without verbose xml_payload field, supports kind and property_id filters
xml_validation: Restrictions XML contains OTA_HotelAvailNotifRQ with RestrictionStatus block
